title: The Amazon IPO with original Amazon Board Member Tom Alberg

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Ben & David welcome very special guest Tom Alberg, board member and first lead investor in Amazon.com.
reader_summary.overview: Ben & David welcome very special guest Tom Alberg, board member and first lead investor in Amazon.com, to cover the IPO of "earth’s most customer-centric company". From longterm thinking to flywheels to riding big waves. We hope you enjoy listening as much as we did recording it!
